description: List House of Commons oral questions tabled for answer at departmental question time from a given date: who is asking, which department and minister answers, and the question text, including topical questions. Answers "what will MPs ask at Home Office questions this week?". Source: UK Parliament Oral Questions and Motions API. Commons only; it lists questions, not what was said in reply (that is in Hansard). (cost: 1 credit)

from_date.description: string, required, YYYY-MM-DD, earliest answering date

take.description: int, optional, number of questions 1-100, default 20

to_date.description: string, optional, YYYY-MM-DD, latest answering date

name: oral_questions_upcoming
